fit_reason: Private owner selling a complete aluminum fishing boat with motor and trailer.
findings: Painted aluminum hull sides look somewhat flat and dull rather than glossy, especially the silver lower sides in the close-up shots
Faint water spotting and light film visible on the lower hull near the rivet line
Gray fold-down seats and rear deck look clean but slightly dusty in the stern photos
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Lowe Line and it looks like it has been well cared for. The silver hull sides look a little flat in the photos, and a wash and wax would bring back the shine on the paint and decals. We do pre-sale details that come to you, including a quick wipe-down of the seats and deck. Would you like a quote?
